```ts
// smoke.ts — the observer context handler (G1: returns void)
pi.on("context", (event, ctx) => {
  try {
    const msgs = event.messages as unknown as Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    const has = (s: string) => msgs.some((m) => JSON.stringify(m).includes(s));
    const entries = ctx.sessionManager.getEntries() as unknown[];
    const hasRewindMarker = entries.some((e) => (e as any)?.type === "custom" && (e as any)?.customType === "mulligan:rewind");
    // G5: role-gate seed detection on role:"assistant" (the prompt also contains the canary text)
    const seedHiddenInAssistant = msgs.some((m) => m?.role === "assistant" && JSON.stringify(m).includes(SEED_HIDDEN));
    smokeLog("context.fire", "info", { count: msgs.length, msgCanaryPresent: has(MSG_CANARY), notePresent: msgs.some((m)=>m?.customType==="mulligan:note"), hasRewindMarker, shrunkInContext: has(SHRUNK_MARKER), hasNudge: msgs.some((m)=>m?.customType==="mulligan:nudge"), seedHiddenInAssistant });
    if (currentScenario === "F-rewind-core" && hasRewindMarker) {
      smokeLog("F-rewind-core.hiding", seedHiddenInAssistant ? "fail" : "pass", { seedHiddenInAssistant });
    }
  } catch (e) { smokeLog("context.fire", "fail", { error: String(e) }); }
  // return void → pass-through; NEVER override Mulligan's filter (G1)
});

// smoke.ts — drive a scenario via the REAL rewind tool (shared module → bound to same pi)
async function rewindNow(pi, ctx, toolCallId, granularity, opts) {
  const tool = makeRewindTool(pi);
  const result = await tool.execute(toolCallId, { note: SMOKE_NOTE, granularity, to_previous_prompt: opts?.to_previous_prompt, checkpoint: opts?.checkpoint }, undefined, undefined, ctx);
  const text = resultText(result.content);
  smokeLog("tool.rewind", "info", { toolCallId, granularity, text: text.slice(0,120) });
  return { text };
}

// run-smoke.mjs — the 2-spawn F-reload flow (shared --session-id reopens the session)
if (scenario === "F-reload") {
  const r1 = runPi(scenario);                         // run 1: create the rewind marker
  const r2 = runPi(scenario, { extraArgs: ["-p", "Reply with exactly: OK"] });  // run 2: observing turn, SAME --session-id
  return { piRes: r1, smoke: parseSmokeLog(r1.logPath), r2, smoke2: parseSmokeLog(r2.logPath) };
}

// run-smoke.mjs — the §2.3 global invariants (asserted for every marker-creating scenario)
function assertGlobalInvariants(results, entries) {
  for (const ct of ["mulligan:rewind", "mulligan:shrink", "mulligan:turn-metric"])
    assert(results, `§2.3 ${ct} are type:custom`, entries.filter((e)=>e.customType===ct && e.type!=="custom").length===0, "");
  assert(results, "§2.3 mulligan:note are type:custom_message", entries.filter((e)=>e.customType==="mulligan:note" && e.type!=="custom_message").length===0, "");
  assert(results, "§2.3 mulligan:checkpoint: are type:label", entries.filter((e)=>typeof e.label==="string" && e.label.startsWith("mulligan:checkpoint:") && e.type!=="label").length===0, "");
  assert(results, "§2.3 ZERO mulligan:nudge on disk", entries.filter((e)=>e.customType==="mulligan:nudge").length===0, "");  // the headline DoD #3 invariant
}
```

test/integration/run-smoke.mjs exists; spawns `pi -e ./src/index.ts -e ./test/integration/smoke.ts --session-id smoke-<scenario>-<RUN_ID> -p …` per scenario with a run-scoped --session-id (RUN_ID for idempotency); parses the smoke JSONL log + session JSONL; runs per-scenario + §2.3-global assertions; exits 0 iff all pass, 1 otherwise; detects EXTENSION-LOAD-FAILED (non-zero pi exit + empty smoke log) distinctly (G12).

test/integration/scenarios.md documents each of the 9 F-* scenarios (drive, prompt flow, log/JSONL observables, pass criteria) plus the harness mechanics (2-extension load order, deterministic-command path, §2.3 invariant table).
package.json `scripts.smoke` === `node test/integration/run-smoke.mjs` (repointed from the load-test); `scripts.test` unchanged.

`npm run smoke` runs all 9 F-* scenarios (F-rewind-core, F-shrink-persist, F-shrink-preventive, F-nudge-drift, F-protected, F-maxdepth, F-checkpoint, F-failopen, F-reload) GREEN against real pi 0.84.1 (exit 0). F-shrink-preventive's bloatHit and F-nudge-drift's hasNudge are SOFT (model-driven; documented in scenarios.md) and do not fail the gate.

ZERO `mulligan:nudge` entries in the session JSONL across ALL scenarios (spec/11 §3 #3 — the headline DoD invariant, asserted by run-smoke.mjs assertGlobalInvariants for every marker-creating scenario).

`npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0 and `npx vitest run` is fully green with NO regressions to the 635 pre-existing tests (the smoke harness is a separate spawned-pi driver, NOT a vitest test, so the fast suite is unaffected).

The spec/10 §3 property tests (pairing invariant, idempotency, monotonic shrinkage) are confirmed GREEN in test/pipeline.test.ts + test/edge-cases.test.ts (already present — no new property tests added).

NO file under src/ is modified by this task (input = the wired extension from P1.M5.T1.S1, unchanged); test/integration/edge-cases.integration.test.ts (T2) is unchanged; README.md is NOT edited (P1.M5.T4 owns it, Mode B); the `/mulligan_smoke` command lives ONLY in test/integration/smoke.ts (`grep -nE 'registerCommand|registerShortcut|sendUserMessage' src/index.ts` prints nothing — D8/C2 hold).
